import type { ComponentDetail } from './component-docs'
import { documentedTokens } from './documented-tokens'

// Authored documentation for the verified Bootstrap 6 pin, not a core adapter.
const steps = `<ol class="stepper theme-inverse" aria-label="Account setup progress">
  <li class="stepper-item active">Account — complete</li>
  <li class="stepper-item active" aria-current="step">Profile — current</li>
  <li class="stepper-item">Confirm — pending</li>
</ol>`
export const stepperExample = steps
export const stepperDetails: ComponentDetail = {
  variants: [
    { title: 'Current and completed steps', description: 'Both completed and current items use active. aria-current and visible status text distinguish the current step; there is no separate complete class.', markup: steps },
    { title: 'Descriptions', description: 'Group additional content in one item child so the generated counter and text occupy the two intended grid columns.', markup: `<ol class="stepper theme-inverse" aria-label="Deployment progress">
  <li class="stepper-item active align-items-start"><div><strong class="d-block">Build — complete</strong><small class="fg-2">Compiled successfully</small></div></li>
  <li class="stepper-item active align-items-start" aria-current="step"><div><strong class="d-block">Review — current</strong><small class="fg-2">Approval pending</small></div></li>
  <li class="stepper-item align-items-start"><div><strong class="d-block">Release — pending</strong><small class="fg-2">Not started</small></div></li>
</ol>` },
    { title: 'Responsive horizontal layout', description: 'Vertical is the default. A query container and sm:stepper-horizontal switch to horizontal based on the available container width, not the viewport.', markup: `<div class="contains-inline">
  <ol class="stepper sm:stepper-horizontal theme-inverse" aria-label="Responsive checkout progress">
    <li class="stepper-item active">Shipping — complete</li>
    <li class="stepper-item active" aria-current="step">Payment — current</li>
    <li class="stepper-item">Review — pending</li>
  </ol>
</div>` },
    { title: 'Horizontal overflow', description: 'The optional overflow wrapper contains a long horizontal sequence. Keyboard users can focus and scroll the labelled region.', markup: `<div class="stepper-overflow" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable onboarding progress">
  <ol class="stepper stepper-horizontal theme-inverse" aria-label="Onboarding progress">
    <li class="stepper-item active">Create account — complete</li>
    <li class="stepper-item active" aria-current="step">Verify email address — current</li>
    <li class="stepper-item">Complete profile setup — pending</li>
    <li class="stepper-item">Add payment method — pending</li>
    <li class="stepper-item">Review and confirm — pending</li>
    <li class="stepper-item">Finish onboarding — pending</li>
  </ol>
</div>` },
    { title: 'Unavailable future step', description: 'Static future items describe prerequisites in text. There is no invented disabled-step plugin or automatic wizard navigation.', markup: `<ol class="stepper theme-inverse" aria-label="Application progress">
  <li class="stepper-item active" aria-current="step">Details — current</li>
  <li class="stepper-item"><div>Documents — unavailable<small class="d-block fg-2">Complete Details first.</small></div></li>
  <li class="stepper-item"><div>Submit — unavailable<small class="d-block fg-2">Upload Documents first.</small></div></li>
</ol>` },
    { title: 'Dark mode and RTL', description: 'Logical connectors adapt to direction. The inverse theme is an explicit accessible counter-color choice in these examples, not a change to the primary core default.', markup: `<div data-trm-theme="dark" dir="rtl" class="p-3 rounded-5 bg-body fg-body">${steps.replace('Account setup progress', 'Setup progress')}</div>` }
  ],
  variables: documentedTokens('stepper'),
  keyboard: [
    { keys: 'Tab / Shift+Tab', behavior: 'Static list items are not tab stops. Native links/buttons, if authored, participate in normal focus order; the overflow region is focusable.' },
    { keys: 'Arrow keys', behavior: 'Scroll a focused overflow wrapper using native browser scrolling. Stepper supplies no roving-focus or wizard behavior.' },
    { keys: 'Enter / Space', behavior: 'Enter activates a native link; Enter or Space activates a native button. The application must implement any step transition.' }
  ],
  guidelines: [
    'Use an ordered list and put stepper-item on each direct item. The CSS counter and connecting track are generated on that class.',
    'Apply active to completed items and the current item, and put aria-current="step" on exactly one current item.',
    'Explain completion, current and unavailable states in text; color alone is insufficient.',
    'Vertical layout needs no extra modifier. Use stepper-horizontal, responsive prefixes with contains-inline, or stepper-overflow deliberately.',
    'The inverse theme used here composes existing theme tokens for counter contrast. It does not change the framework defaults.',
    'This is CSS presentation, not a multi-step form controller. Validate data and implement navigation in the application.'
  ],
  sass: `@use 'tremplin/scss/stepper' with (
  $stepper-tokens: (
    --trm-stepper-size: 2.5rem,
    --trm-stepper-gap: 1.5rem
  )
);`
}

const slide = (title: string, text: string, index: number, count: number, surface = 'bg-1') => `<div class="carousel-item${index === 0 ? ' active' : ''}" role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="${index + 1} of ${count}"><div class="p-4 rounded-5 ${surface} fg-body" style="min-block-size: 10rem"><h3 class="h5">${title}</h3><p class="mb-0">${text}</p></div></div>`
const controls = (id: string, indicators = false) => `<div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-center align-items-center gap-2">
  <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse btn-icon" type="button" data-trm-slide="prev" data-trm-target="#${id}" aria-label="Previous slide"><span class="carousel-icon-prev" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
  ${indicators ? `<div class="carousel-indicators"><button type="button" class="active" data-trm-slide-to="0" data-trm-target="#${id}" aria-label="Slide 1" aria-current="true"></button><button type="button" data-trm-slide-to="1" data-trm-target="#${id}" aria-label="Slide 2"></button><button type="button" data-trm-slide-to="2" data-trm-target="#${id}" aria-label="Slide 3"></button></div>` : ''}
  <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse btn-icon" type="button" data-trm-slide="next" data-trm-target="#${id}" aria-label="Next slide"><span class="carousel-icon-next" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
</div>`
export const carouselExample = `<div class="carousel" id="demo-carousel" role="region" aria-label="Featured projects">
  <div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Featured project slides">${slide('First slide', 'Plan the next milestone.', 0, 2)}${slide('Second slide', 'Build and review the interface.', 1, 2, 'bg-2')}</div>
  ${controls('demo-carousel')}
</div>`
export const carouselDetails: ComponentDetail = {
  variants: [
    { title: 'Controls and indicators', description: 'Keep controls inside the labelled carousel, but outside its scroll viewport. Explicit 24px indicator tokens make the small target example easier to operate.', markup: `<div class="carousel" id="carousel-controls" role="region" aria-label="Project highlights" style="--trm-carousel-indicator-width: 1.5rem; --trm-carousel-indicator-height: 1.5rem">
  <div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Project highlight slides">${slide('Plan', 'Define tokens and component contracts.', 0, 3)}${slide('Build', 'Implement accessible interactions.', 1, 3, 'bg-2')}${slide('Ship', 'Verify packages and documentation.', 2, 3, 'bg-3')}</div>
  ${controls('carousel-controls', true)}
</div>` },
    { title: 'Multi-item layout and peek', description: 'The items, gap and peek tokens control scroll-snap geometry. Unit-bearing gaps are required; initialize an instance before relying on active-slide tracking during direct scrolling.', markup: `<div class="carousel carousel-center" id="carousel-multi" role="region" aria-label="Team projects" style="--trm-carousel-items: 2; --trm-carousel-items-gap: 1rem; --trm-carousel-items-peek: 1rem">
  <div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Team project slides">${slide('Design system', 'Tokens and patterns.', 0, 3)}${slide('Dashboard', 'Operational metrics.', 1, 3, 'bg-2')}${slide('Portal', 'Customer workflows.', 2, 3, 'bg-3')}</div>
  ${controls('carousel-multi')}
</div>` },
    { title: 'Fade transition', description: 'carousel-fade stacks slides and switches the active item instead of scrolling. No old slide, alert-color or button-color aliases are needed.', markup: `<div class="carousel carousel-fade" id="carousel-fade" role="region" aria-label="Release stages">
  <div class="carousel-inner">${slide('Alpha', 'API exploration.', 0, 2)}${slide('Beta', 'Production hardening.', 1, 2, 'bg-2')}</div>
  <div class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-center gap-2"><button class="btn-outline theme-inverse btn-sm" type="button" data-trm-slide="prev" data-trm-target="#carousel-fade">Previous</button><button class="btn-outline theme-inverse btn-sm" type="button" data-trm-slide="next" data-trm-target="#carousel-fade">Next</button></div>
</div>` },
    { title: 'Autoplay with pause control', description: 'This example starts paused. Play explicitly starts a six-second cycle; Pause, arrows, manual controls or pointer interaction stop autoplay intent. The pause-on-hover option temporarily suspends a running timer.', markup: `<div class="carousel" id="carousel-autoplay" role="region" aria-label="Announcements" data-trm-autoplay="false" data-trm-interval="6000">
  <div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Announcement slides">${slide('Documentation release', 'Read the latest guides.', 0, 2)}${slide('New starter templates', 'Explore the available project patterns.', 1, 2, 'bg-2')}</div>
  <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse btn-icon align-self-center carousel-control-play-pause paused" type="button" data-trm-target="#carousel-autoplay" data-trm-pause-label="Pause announcements" data-trm-play-label="Play announcements" aria-label="Play announcements"><span class="carousel-icon-pause" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="carousel-icon-play" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
</div>` },
    { title: 'Dark mode and RTL', description: 'Direction-aware navigation and masked icons work without alternate framework stylesheets. Plain slide content avoids duplicate IDs during loop cloning.', markup: `<div data-trm-theme="dark" dir="rtl" class="p-3 rounded-5 bg-body fg-body"><div class="carousel" id="carousel-rtl" role="region" aria-label="Framework features">
  <div class="carousel-inner" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Framework feature slides">${slide('Responsive layout', 'Flexible grids for different screens.', 0, 2)}${slide('Accessible components', 'Keyboard and focus behavior.', 1, 2, 'bg-2')}</div>
  ${controls('carousel-rtl')}
</div></div>` }
  ],
  variables: documentedTokens('carousel'),
  keyboard: [
    { keys: 'ArrowLeft / ArrowRight', behavior: 'Once initialized, navigate previous/next respecting RTL, except while typing in an input or textarea. This stops autoplay intent.' },
    { keys: 'Tab / Shift+Tab', behavior: 'Use native focus order through the scroll viewport, controls and any authored slide links. Offscreen slide focus is not a roving-tablist contract.' },
    { keys: 'Enter / Space', behavior: 'Activate a focused native previous/next, indicator or play/pause button.' }
  ],
  guidelines: [
    'Name the region and slides, mark one starting slide active and give every carousel its own ID. Control data-trm-target values must resolve to their owning carousel.',
    'The scroll viewport and slides use real scroll-snap geometry. Set slide dimensions as needed; nested carousels are unsupported.',
    'The data API initializes on a control click. Active tracking during direct scrolling or keyboard control before that requires Carousel.getOrCreateInstance(element).',
    'data-trm-autoplay="true" automatically initializes on page load. Do not initialize the same autoplay carousel twice. This documentation example starts paused for predictable, user-controlled motion.',
    'Provide a visible pause control whenever autoplay is enabled. Pressing a manual control or dragging stops autoplay intent; focus alone is not an advertised auto-pause policy.',
    'Use actual button variants plus named masked icons. The inverse theme and larger indicator tokens shown here are explicit composition choices, not new core defaults.',
    'Verify keyboard direction, native touch scrolling, reduced motion, page zoom and RTL on the devices your application supports.'
  ],
  sass: `@use 'tremplin/scss/carousel' with (
  $carousel-tokens: (
    --trm-carousel-gap: 1rem,
    --trm-carousel-control-icon-width: 1.25rem
  )
);`
}
